senses.gloss: (b. h.) = שׁוּף I, to blow, pant, long for.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 131</cite> <cite ref="K00792"><he>כמו</he></cite> (<cite ref="U00489"><he>ש</he></cite>)<he>התנינים שׁוֹאֲפִים לרוח כן הייתי שׁוֹאֵף לתורתך</he> (not <he>רוהך</he>) as the monsters pant for wind, so do I pant (longing) for thy Law.
